134:    - Extending the regex from `\u0430-\u044F` to `\u0430-\u045F` ensures all lowercase Slavic characters are matched by the TitleCase/lowercase word branch `[A-Z...]?[a-z\u00DF-\u024F\u0430-\u045F]+`, preventing unnatural token fragmentation.
